name: Rockchip RK3588
notes: Wikipedia lists RK3588, RK3588S, RK3588S2, RK3588C on one row ('RK3588 RK3588S RK3588S2 RK3588C'). Wikipedia tables give different dates for this chip ('2022' (List of Rockchip products § ARMv8-A processors), 'Q3/Q4 2020' (Rockchip § ARMv8-A processors)); no date is given. Wikipedia tables give different CPU clocks for this chip (2.4 GHz; 2.6/1.8 GHz); they are left out.
